title: CalendarPackContents
description: The artefact.contents of a RulePackStaged payload whose packType is exactly calendar (INV-REQ-83, INV-REQ-87, INV-REQ-88, INV-REQ-1350). Names are those of the CalendarPack of calendar-and-periods 1.0.0. The envelope schema rule-pack-staged-payload.schema.json keeps contents opaque and is unchanged. There is no transition property: a frequency change is cut only at the change date (INV-AC-154), and a consumer ignores a transition property or any other property this schema does not name (API-41, FR-K.4); no object of this schema sets additionalProperties to false. A later schema version adds one only by a new ruling and task. Rules a JSON Schema cannot express are tested by the decoder task, not here: the windows of one frequency do not overlap; a window ends on or after its start; every window's returnForm and finalReturnForm each has a due rule in dueRules; at least one day of the week is not in weekend. Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4). The optional properties alertThresholds, safetyMargin and entrySources carry the default deadline-alert thresholds, the safety margin and the source class and citation of each entry (INV-REQ-1117, INV-REQ-1279, INV-REQ-774).

windows.description: Filing windows by filing-frequency code; each value lists the windows of that frequency.

additionalProperties.description: The windows of one filing frequency.

end.description: Last day of the window; on or after start.

returnForm.description: The return form filed for the window.

finalReturnForm.description: The return form of the final return.

dueRules.description: Due rules keyed by return form.

monthsAfterEnd.description: Whole months after the window end.

endOfMonth.description: Whether the due date moves to the end of that month.

weekend.description: The days of the week that are not working days.

pinnedRule.description: The non-business-day rule the pack pins (INV-REQ-87); absent means the pack pins nothing.

alertThresholds.description: Default deadline-alert thresholds by filing-frequency code (INV-REQ-1117, INV-REQ-80, INV-Q-6554): each value lists the days before the due date of the alerts, the first alert first. The thresholds fall strictly from the first alert to the last and every key is a key of windows; the decoder task tests both, JSON Schema cannot. A pack without thresholds for a frequency of windows is refused by rules-svc at pack import and dry run, and no consumer substitutes a constant (INV-REQ-1350).

additionalProperties.description: The alert thresholds of one filing frequency, in days before the due date, the first alert first.

safetyMargin.description: The default safety margin before a due date (INV-REQ-1279, INV-Q-6554): a value and a unit. The value is at most 366 when the unit is DAYS. A pack without safetyMargin is refused by rules-svc at pack import and dry run, and no consumer substitutes a constant (INV-REQ-1350).

entrySources.description: The source class and citation of the entries of the pack (INV-REQ-774, INV-REQ-727, INV-Q-6556), one row per entry. A windows row names the frequency and the window start date, a dueRules row the return form, a holidays row the day, an alertThresholds row the frequency; finalReturnForm, weekend, pinnedRule and safetyMargin are one entry each with no key. That every entry has exactly one row and that a row names an entry the pack holds is the check of rules-svc and of the seed content test (INV-AC-1727). An entry without a row is never read as PRIMARY.

section.description: The property of the contents the entry belongs to.

frequency.description: The filing-frequency code of a windows or alertThresholds entry.

returnForm.description: The return form of a dueRules entry.

date.description: The window start date of a windows entry, or the day of a holidays entry.

sourceClass.description: The source class of the entry: PRIMARY, SECONDARY or INFERRED.
